start.title: A journey through the worlds of our ecosystem.
start.subtitle: A course charted to meet your specific needs or spark your interests. Scroll to begin the exploration and choose where to land.

intro.title: One ecosystem. Infinite touchpoints.
intro.text: Neo Galaxy is not confined to a single form, but lives in the synergy of its worlds. Every element of our ecosystem is a tangible answer to a real need: connected fragments that chart a single, grand course. From the spark of the Community to the architecture of the Software House, all the way to the guided growth of the Academy: from data to the bigger picture. Scroll to begin the journey and chart your orbit.

community.title: Neo Galaxy Community
community.description: The ultimate gathering place where passions come alive. From gaming to anime, music to TV series, we bring people together through shared interests. A vibrant experience, powered by ongoing events and special projects like our dedicated Minecraft servers and Roleplay sessions. Step in, connect, and cultivate your hobbies with us.

ngsh.title: Neo Galaxy Software House
ngsh.description: The technological and productive core of Neo Galaxy, where ideas become code. We operate on two fronts: the distribution and release of proprietary software and services, and tailor-made freelance development for external clients. Professionalism and technical execution at the service of your digital needs.

academy.title: Neo Galaxy Academy
academy.description: The space where theory becomes skill and mutual support creates value. Our Academy welcomes students into a collaborative Discord environment, perfect for studying in synergy and overcoming academic challenges together. In parallel, it operates in the professional education sector, providing private tutoring and advanced IT training courses to prepare you for tomorrow's technological challenges.

map.title: Galaxy map
map.subtitle: All the ecosystem's projects, at a single glance. Select a destination to go back and explore it.
